[[File:Remduba_system_convoy_AoRCR.png|thumb|right|250px|The Perlemian Haul traveling through the [[Remduba system]]]]
The '''Perlemian Haul''' was the codename of a rumored [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] operating along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The convoy included [[Temple-class heavy freighter|''Temple''-class heavy freighters]] and two [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigates]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] confirmed its existence and sent a team of operatives to secure its mysterious cargo. They [[Hijacking of Freighter M226|infiltrated]] [[freighter M226]].<ref name="PH adventure">{{FFG|story=Perlemian Haul (adventure)|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The convoy appears in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure [[Perlemian Haul (adventure)|''Perlemian Haul'']], included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]].<ref name="PH adventure" />
